facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice grew big and then small. She met a smiling cat. Nothing made sense here. Everything was strange.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice kept changing size by eating and drinking strange things. She met a Cheshire Cat with a huge grin floating in the air. The cat told her that everyone in Wonderland was completely mad. Everything was strange and nothing followed the rules she knew. Cakes made her grow tall and drinks made her shrink down. Alice felt confused but curious about this upside-down world.
